schedule: games remaining, byes
nfl.qb_career_milestone_accrual.why: Only the career component applies here (KXNFLCAREERPASSTDS); the single-season accrual series moved out of this archetype, so the season part of this catalog definition is not claimed.

nfl.model_team_td_mean.label: Market-free team touchdown mean (drives times TD-per-drive, with FG-vs-TD split)
nfl.model_team_td_mean.mechanism: A team's expected touchdowns are expected drives times the per-drive probability of ending in a touchdown rather than a field goal or no score, estimated from opponent-adjusted offence and defence and red-zone conversion, with no spread, total or price as a feature.
nfl.model_team_td_mean.rationale: Every scorer market is a share of the team's touchdown pool. A points-based implied team total is market-derived and is not touchdown-specific (24 points can be 3 TD + FG or 2 TD + 3 FG). A model-derived TD mean keeps wind, availability and matchup visible and gives P(team scores at least one TD), the quantity the team-own first-TD contract depends on.
nfl.model_team_td_mean.measurement: lambda_TD(team i vs j) = E[drives_i] x P(TD | drive). E[drives] from both teams' neutral seconds per play and expected plays (2015+ pbp, shrink 50/50 to league at 8 games). P(TD|drive) = logistic ridge on own opponent-adjusted offensive EPA per play (half-life 8 games, prior-season weight 0.3 fading to 0 by week 10), opponent defensive EPA per play, red-zone trips per drive and red-zone TD rate (shrunk k=30 trips), 4th-and-goal go-for-it rate (k=12), wind>15 mph and dome flags, starting-QB indicator. Output mean, variance (overdispersion from tercile residuals) and P(N>=1)=1-exp(-lambda_TD) with a negative-binomial correction. As-of: after the previous game, refreshed at the final injury report. Spreads, totals and prices excluded; used only afterwards as a benchmark.
free_sources: nflverse pbp (drive results, redzone, td flags)
raw_data: pbp: drive, posteam, drive_end_transition, touchdown, epa, yardline_100, fourth_down_converted
schedules: wind, roof, starting QBs
nfl.model_team_td_mean.why: Supplies the team TD pool from which the pass-versus-run split near the goal line yields the QB's passing TDs, without a market-implied total.

nfl.red_zone_target_quality.label: Red-zone catcher quality and availability (contested-catch and size-weighted target value)
nfl.red_zone_target_quality.mechanism: The probability that a red-zone or goal-to-go throw becomes a touchdown depends on who is the target: tall, contested-catch receivers and tight ends convert short throws at higher rates than slot receivers, so QB touchdown counts depend on the supporting cast.
nfl.red_zone_target_quality.rationale: nfl.skill_avail captures absences but not the quality level of red-zone catchers; a QB with a dominant red-zone target has a higher per-attempt TD rate independent of his own skill, and a team's passing-TD count is lost when that player is out or replaced.
nfl.red_zone_target_quality.measurement: For each team-week, rz_target_quality = sum over players of (share of team targets inside the opponent 20 over the last 12 games, half-life 6 games) x (player's red-zone catch rate over expected, shrunk to the league mean with k=20 red-zone targets) x (availability weight from the active/inactive status at the as-of time); standardise across teams within season; output the team value and the value lost when the top red-zone target is replaced by the next on the chart. As-of: after the previous game and updated at the inactive list.

interactions.mechanism: Passing TDs equal the team's TD count times the pass fraction near the goal line; a team that scores mostly through field goals and long runs, or that runs the ball inside the 5, converts a high total into few passing TDs; the product of TD pool and pass share matters, not either one.
interactions.how_to_test: Regress QB TDs on the model team TD mean, goal-to-go pass rate and their product.

interactions.mechanism: Pressure increases interception probability mainly for QBs with a high turnover-worthy throw rate and mostly when the coverage behind it is zone with ball-hawk safeties; the effect is conditional on both QB trait and defence structure.
interactions.how_to_test: Estimate INT probability by pressure bucket within QB aggression terciles and coverage type.

interactions.mechanism: A large lead in the fourth quarter shifts the state from attempts accumulating to the QB being pulled; the same favourite who runs more also loses its QB for the end of the game, capping TD counts and voiding protected contracts, so attempts are a mixture over two regimes.
interactions.how_to_test: Compare QB attempts and pull rates by pregame spread bucket and halftime lead.

interactions.mechanism: Above a wind threshold of about 15 mph deep passing falls and goal-line plays tilt toward the run or sneak; passing TD expectation drops more for QBs who depend on deep targets and less for short-game QBs.
interactions.how_to_test: Split QB-games by wind bucket and compare TD per attempt relative to xPassTD.

interactions.mechanism: If the red-zone TE or WR1 is out, TD per attempt in the red zone falls by more than the loss in yardage-based production because the backup lacks size or contested-catch ability; the effect is concentrated on short-yardage throws.
interactions.how_to_test: Compare red-zone TD per attempt with and without the top red-zone target, controlling for QB.

nonlinearities.why: The probability of 4+ TDs is convex in the mean TD count; small changes in expected attempts and pass share near 2 TDs expected multiply the tail probability by a large factor.
Interceptions rise slowly with pressure rate at low levels and then steeply when pressure exceeds roughly 35-40% of dropbacks, as throws become hurried and off-balance.
QB pull probability is near zero until the lead reaches about 21 with under ten minutes left, then jumps to high levels, which truncates counts and triggers protected-contract voids.
The weight of a QB's realized TD rate versus expectation rises with attempts, with half the weight around a thousand attempts; short samples are mostly noise.
